queries.provenance_note: Center City rail trunk: all 13 Regional Rail lines converge on the Suburban-Jefferson-30th St trunk; shortest rail hop in the set.
Center City surface trunk: the L1 Market-Frankford ride from its eastern terminal into 13th St; the bus family's highest-ridership corridor pattern.
Surface-only neighborhood pair: South Philadelphia (Snyder/Broad) to Northern Liberties/Kensington (Girard/Front) on bus/trolley corridors; no rail-family stop at either end.

Rail-inclusive suburb->Center City: Lansdale/Doylestown line to Jefferson Station (rail 90006), then the 384 m cross-family walk edge Jefferson->13th St (bus) as the egress — the journey cannot complete as designed without a coordinate-built cross-family edge.

Cross-family transfer pair: bus ride to Norristown TC, the 93 m cross-family walk edge to Norristown Transit Center (rail 90226, idx 13529), Regional Rail (Manayunk/Norristown line) to Temple. Exercises a mid-journey family change, not just an egress.
Airport Line to Center City — the region's signature rail-inclusive trip; 30-min airport headway against the trunk's combined frequency at the destination end.

Saturday case on the Saturday signatures (bus B:SIG07, rail R:SIG03): L1 into Center City with a cross-family egress to the rail station (via the 259 m Suburban<->JFK & 15th edge or a subway-stop walk chain).

Evening thin-service case: 21:30 departure against the rail family's 60-120 min evening headways (density D3) — the pair the flat +30-min bound is expected to bind on, and the frequency-aware bound to answer.
Subway-surface trolley pair: route 34 (Baltimore Av) from West Philadelphia to 13th St, direct or via the 40th St portal / L1 transfer.
Surface crosstown: Kensington to West Philadelphia entirely on the surface family — through Center City on trolleys/buses or around it; the set's longest surface-only candidate pool.

Walk-chain stress (the PHL analog of Detroit's HIST2 walk-explosion regression): origin and destination ~534 m apart straight-line with no direct <=400 m edge — the planner must choose between a chained walk through intermediate stops (30-min cumulative cap), a rail overshoot to Suburban + bus back, or a bus from a nearby stop.
